worthConsidering.issue: A locked occurrence of an asset can incorrectly prevent duplicating another occurrence on an unlocked track.
worthConsidering.reproduction: Use the same image/audio asset on track A and track B, with A's clip first in p.clips. Lock A, select B's unlocked clip and Duplicate. Its new id misses the id lookup, the asset lookup picks A's clip, and the source-track guard rejects the valid addition to B.
worthConsidering.fix: Distinguish existing-id updates from additions. Apply the old/source-track lock check only to the actual existing-id clip; always check the destination track. Copy-to-unlocked-track can then work without weakening locked-track edits.
worthConsidering.validation: Source-confirmed path; supplied browser regression covers duplication into the locked track itself, not this shared-asset case.

worthConsidering.issue: Adding or shortening clips while playing retains the timeline duration captured when playback began.
worthConsidering.fix: Pause on duration-changing edits or read current timeline duration in the transport tick. This unchanged optional issue does not undermine the fixed seek path.

skipIt: The transition-video branch retains width-based sizing, but this adapter exposes no transitions; no current preview workflow regression is asserted.
No new abstraction or dependency is needed for the fixes; the direct guards and per-clip element map are proportionate.
